profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: My short term goals are to advance my knowledge and experience in the technology industry, specifically from the standpoint of a software developer while expanding my network and credentials. I would like to attend graduate school in the near future to attain a Master's degree in Computer Science. My long term goal is to work in an interesting, engaging and challenging position with good opportunities for career growth.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description: I worked with this cutting edge database technology, mainly developing the testing suite for various components of the software, and the performance of the software under resource limitations. I also worked on developing a SQL parser for compiling queries, and contributed to the development of database features.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description: Unix shell work especially relating to file transfer, database management, support for data tools such as SAS and Informatica, write PERL scripts for file migration

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing the Program Definition Language they use to support their platform as well as writing client programs for message schedules in this language.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Assist construction of ACCESS particle detector, conduct computer board testing, basic electronics modifications, present progress updates

positions.title: Librarian Assistant
positions.description: Perform detailed, complex tasks, work in a high volume and fast-paced environment, learn multiple types of equipment and proprietary software

positions.title: Lifeguard
positions.description: Interact with people from many different age groups and backgrounds, pay attention to detail with many individuals to monitor, provide lifesaving care in cases of emergencies

company.name: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

educations.fieldOfStudy: Double Major in Physics and Computer Science

courses.name: Differential Equations for Scientists and Engineers

volunteerExperiences.description: We lived and worked in the back country of Yellowstone National Park, mostly rebuilding trails. This opportunity spoke to me because I am passionate about spending time outdoors, and a chance to experience an incredible national park while donating my time and effort to a good cause felt too good to be true.
